project.title: Microbial communities in hydrogen-assisted anaerobic digestion for simultaneous conversion of organic matter and CO2 to methane
project.description: Hydrogen-assisted anaerobic digestion was investigated as a strategy for the simultaneous biological conversion of sewage sludge organic matter and endogenous CO2 into biomethane. Two continuous stirred-tank bioreactors were operated for 152 days under mesophilic conditions: a conventional control reactor (R1) and a reactor supplied with external H2 (R2). Hydrogen addition increased methane content from 60 to around 90% while COD and VS removal remained comparable to the control, confirming that methane enrichment resulted mainly from biological CO2 reduction. Microbial diversity and composition were analyzed by 16S rRNA gene metabarcoding at 18 days in both reactors and the substrates, in duplicate, resulting in 74 sequencing samples.
